Our personalised raccoon word art print turns a raccoon in shades of grey into a one-off picture made entirely from words. It looks lovely in a bedroom, nursery or living room.

Your personalised raccoon word art print, made with your words

Fill in two boxes: the name, which sits once prominently in the design, and your word list of 20 to 30 words separated by commas, such as hobbies, nicknames, family names and favourite places. We repeat the words randomly in different sizes, fonts and shades across the design, and the preview shows what you've typed next to the print photo.

Tips: use single words or phrases of no more than three words, put commas between them and check your spelling. No icons, emoji or accented letters, please. We print exactly what you type.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • The name stands out once, and your other words repeat in different sizes, fonts and shades
  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1

Size & details

  • Design: a raccoon in shades of grey, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised raccoon word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.
